sanitization.images: omitted; text/DOM/network evidence was sufficient and avoids incidental UI state

sourceFindings.preconditions: seeded QA server; QA Local Embeddings points to http://127.0.0.1:22129/v1; active gateway key is returned to the browser as a masked prefix ending in a Unicode ellipsis
steps: Open the QA Local Embeddings media-provider detail
Leave the prefilled masked API key in place
sourceFindings.expected: The example sends POST /api/v1/embeddings locally and renders the mock numeric vector, or requires a usable key before enabling Run.
sourceFindings.actual: Run fails before any network request because the masked key containing U+2026 is copied into the Authorization header: Failed to read the headers property from RequestInit: String contains non ISO-8859-1 code point. The same masked-key loading pattern exists in the image, TTS, STT, and embedding example components.
sourceFindings.console: none; the error is rendered in the Example card
sourceFindings.network: no /api/v1/embeddings request was issued; failure occurred while constructing the browser request headers

sourceFindings.route: /dashboard/providers (+ provider detail, quota, and media modal routes)
sourceFindings.control: Provider, connection, quota, and custom-embedding modal dialogs
steps: Open Add OpenAI Compatible, Add API Key, Edit Compatible Node, Codex Reset Credit Expiry, or Add Custom Embedding
Inspect accessibility semantics and active element
Dismiss with Escape and inspect focus
sourceFindings.expected: Each modal exposes role=dialog with aria-modal and an accessible title, moves focus inside, traps focus, and returns focus to its trigger when closed.
sourceFindings.actual: The audited modal containers expose no dialog role or aria-modal; document.body remains active on open, and focus returns to body rather than the invoking control after Escape.

sourceFindings.control: Connection reorder and model test/copy icon buttons
sourceFindings.preconditions: seeded QA Local Chat detail with three connections; ephemeral detail with two custom models
steps: Tab through connection move controls and model actions
sourceFindings.expected: Icon-only actions have task-oriented accessible names such as Move QA Chat Ready down, Test qa-chat, and Copy qa-chat.
sourceFindings.actual: Several actions have no aria-label/title and expose only Material Symbols ligature text such as keyboard_arrow_down, science, and content_copy; actions are ambiguous to screen-reader users and repeated controls are indistinguishable.

sourceFindings.control: Provider, Authentication Method, API Key, and Display Name fields
sourceFindings.preconditions: seeded QA server; empty Add New Provider form
steps: Inspect visual labels and each control's programmatic name
sourceFindings.expected: Every form control is programmatically associated with its visual label and required errors are associated with the invalid controls.
sourceFindings.actual: The four visual label elements have empty htmlFor values, the controls have no ids/aria-labels, and required error paragraphs are not exposed as role=alert or associated through aria-describedby/aria-invalid.

sourceFindings.preconditions: seeded custom embedding detail and no-auth Edge TTS detail
steps: Open a media-provider detail with an Example card
Tab through Model/Endpoint/API Key/Input/Dimensions or Input/Output Format
sourceFindings.expected: Example inputs and selects expose their visible Row labels as accessible names.
sourceFindings.actual: The audited Example inputs/selects have no associated label, id, or aria-label even though visible text labels are rendered beside them.
